title: Improving the recovery of phenolics and flavonoids from Coriandrum sativum L. leaves using microwave-enzymatic-assisted extraction
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2627-2646
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00536A, Paper

Tan Phat Vo, Minh Thu Nguyen, Thuy Anh Nguyen, Gia Vinh Nguyen, Hoang Nhan Nguyen, Gia Bao Pham, Minh Hoa Ha, Dinh Quan Nguyen
This study focused on optimizing the extraction of phenolic compounds and flavonoids from leaves of Coriandrum sativum L. using a sequential green extraction approach based on microwave-enzymatic-assisted extraction (MEAE).
